newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dell vows to stay with Intel.
newsitem.headline: Dell vows to stay with Intel.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp chief executive Michael Dell said on Tuesday the company would continue using microchips from Intel Corp, despite the arrival of less expensive, equally powerful alternatives.
"We have wasted a lot of money investigating Intel alternatives over the last 10 years," he said at a news conference. "We are staying with Intel."
Advanced Micro Deivces Inc. and Cyrix Corp recently began shipping chips that match the performance and undercut the prices of Intel's top processors.
The arrival of the rivals was one factor analysts suspected in Intel's recent warning about weak demand in Europe.
In Europe, the PC unit of Fujitsu and Germany's Vobis Microcomputer AG have begun using the AMD K6 chip along with Pentium chips.
IBM Corp., which manufactures chips for Cyrix, uses Cyrix chips in some PCs
